text_analysis.original_text: Have you ever walked into a room… and suddenly became hyper-aware of yourself? How you look. How you talk. Whether people are judging you. Whether you sound stupid. Whether you’re enough. Most people spend their entire lives trapped in this invisible prison. But one day… something changes. You realize something shocking: Nobody cares. Not in a cruel way. Not because you’re worthless. But because everyone is too busy worrying about themselves. And the moment you truly understand this… You become dangerous. Because fear loses control over you.
